hooks.name: no-console-log
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); CONTENT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$ ]] && printf '%s' "$CONTENT" | grep -qE 'console\.log'; then echo 'Warning: console.log statements should be removed before committing' >&2; exit 2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: prettier
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$ ]]; then npx --no-install prettier --write "$FILE" >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: tsc
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then npx --no-install tsc --noEmit >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: log-notifications
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); mkdir -p ~/.gemini; echo "Gemini CLI notification: $(date)" >> ~/.gemini/notifications.log; echo '{}'

hooks.name: eslint-changed
hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; if [[ -f package.json ]] && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR | grep -E '\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$' | xargs -r npx --no-install eslint >&2; fi; echo '{}'
